## Summary
Build the formative results view and "Why Wrong?" panel that uses Haiku to explain why each distractor is incorrect and why the correct answer is right, displayed after a student completes a practice session.

## User story
As a student, I want to see why my wrong answers were incorrect with detailed explanations, so that I can learn from my mistakes and understand the underlying concepts.

## Why this matters
Without "Why Wrong?" explanations, students know they got something wrong but not why. This is the most critical learning moment — the distractor explanation bridges the gap between practice and knowledge acquisition. Incorrect implementation could provide misleading medical information.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] API route POST /api/items/[id]/why-wrong returns Haiku-generated explanations
- [ ] Haiku response parsed via safeJsonParse (Rule 2) — never raw JSON.parse
- [ ] HAIKU_MODEL constant used (Rule 4) — never hardcoded model string
- [ ] Item content sanitized via sanitizeForContext before prompt injection (Rule 5)
- [ ] Prompt loaded from packages/ai/prompts/why-wrong.md — never inline (AP-12)
- [ ] WhyWrongPanel shows: correct answer rationale, each distractor explanation, related concept
- [ ] FormativeResults shows item-by-item results with expand-to-explain affordance
- [ ] Explanations are cached in Supabase (why_wrong_cache table) to avoid repeat Haiku calls
- [ ] Loading state with skeleton while Haiku generates explanation

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Rule 2 (H06) | safeJsonParse for Haiku response — JSON.parse crashes on ~1-3% of responses |
| Rule 4 (D05) | HAIKU_MODEL from packages/ai/constants.ts — never hardcode model string |
| Rule 5 (H12) | sanitizeForContext + buildContextBlock for item content in prompt |
| Atomic Design | WhyWrongPanel is an organism in features/why-wrong/components/ |
| AP-12 | Prompt in packages/ai/prompts/why-wrong.md — never inline LLM prompts |

## API contract
```
POST /app/api/items/[id]/why-wrong
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Request: { student_answer_index: number }
Response 200: {
  data: {
    correct_answer: {
      index: number,
      text: string,
      rationale: string
    },
    distractors: [
      {
        index: number,
        text: string,
        why_wrong: string,
        misconception: string,
        related_concept: string
      }
    ],
    cached: boolean
  },
  error: null
}
Response 401: { data: null, error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Not authenticated' } }
Response 404: { data: null, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Item not found' } }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/why-wrong/services/WhyWrongService.ts
import { safeJsonParse } from '@journey/ai/safe-parse';
import { sanitizeForContext, buildContextBlock } from '@journey/ai/sanitize';
import { HAIKU_MODEL } from '@journey/ai/constants';
import { loadPrompt } from '@journey/ai/prompts';
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/client';

export class WhyWrongService {
  async getExplanation(itemId: string, distractorIndex: number) {
    const supabase = createServerClient();

    // Check cache first
    const { data: cached } = await supabase
      .from('why_wrong_cache')
      .select()
      .eq('item_id', itemId)
      .eq('distractor_index', distractorIndex)
      .single();

    if (cached) return { ...cached.explanation, cached: true };

    // Load item content + sanitize (Rule 5)
    const item = await this.loadItem(itemId);
    const sanitizedContent = sanitizeForContext(item.stem);
    const contextBlock = buildContextBlock('item_content', sanitizedContent);

    // Load prompt template (AP-12)
    const prompt = await loadPrompt('why-wrong', { item: contextBlock });

    // Call Haiku (Rule 4)
    const response = await anthropic.messages.create({
      model: HAIKU_MODEL,
      messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }],
      max_tokens: 1024,
    });

    // Parse with safeJsonParse (Rule 2)
    const { data: explanation } = safeJsonParse<WhyWrongExplanation>(
      response.content[0].text
    );

    // Cache result
    await supabase.from('why_wrong_cache').insert({
      item_id: itemId,
      distractor_index: distractorIndex,
      explanation,
      model_used: HAIKU_MODEL,
    });

    return { ...explanation, cached: false };
  }
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ AP-02: JSON.parse without safeJsonParse
const explanation = JSON.parse(haikuResponse.content[0].text); // BANNED
// ✓ Use: const { data } = safeJsonParse<T>(haikuResponse.content[0].text);

// ✗ AP-04: Hardcoded model string
model: 'claude-haiku-4-20250514' // BANNED
// ✓ Use: model: HAIKU_MODEL

// ✗ AP-05: Unsanitized content in prompt
const prompt = `Explain why this is wrong: ${item.stem}`; // BANNED
// ✓ Use: sanitizeForContext(item.stem) + buildContextBlock(...)

// ✗ AP-12: Inline LLM prompt
const systemPrompt = "You are a medical education expert..."; // BANNED
// ✓ Use: loadPrompt('why-wrong', { ... })
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E08/E08-S04.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('POST /api/items/[id]/why-wrong returns 401 without auth', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post('/api/items/test-item-id/why-wrong', {
    data: { student_answer_index: 1 }
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(401);
});

test('POST /api/items/[id]/why-wrong returns explanation for valid item', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token, itemId } = await getTestTokenAndItem(request, 'student');
  const res = await request.post(`/api/items/${itemId}/why-wrong`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    data: { student_answer_index: 1 }
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.correct_answer).toBeDefined();
  expect(data.correct_answer.rationale).toBeTruthy();
  expect(data.distractors).toBeDefined();
  expect(data.distractors.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
});

test('POST /api/items/[id]/why-wrong returns cached result on second call', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token, itemId } = await getTestTokenAndItem(request, 'student');
  // First call
  await request.post(`/api/items/${itemId}/why-wrong`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    data: { student_answer_index: 1 }
  });
  // Second call should be cached
  const res = await request.post(`/api/items/${itemId}/why-wrong`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    data: { student_answer_index: 1 }
  });
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.cached).toBe(true);
});

// tests/E08/E08-S04.ui.test.ts
test('Why Wrong panel renders explanation on click', async ({ page }) => {
  await loginAsStudent(page);
  await navigateToCompletedSession(page);
  await page.locator('[data-testid="why-wrong-trigger"]').first().click();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="why-wrong-panel"]')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/correct answer/i)).toBeVisible();
});
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.why_wrong_cache CASCADE;`
2. Remove files: features/why-wrong/*, app/api/items/[id]/why-wrong/*, packages/ai/prompts/why-wrong.md
3. `git stash && git checkout develop`
